visual.general_description: An alluvial diagram (A) and four circular taxonomy charts (B to E) for the oral cavity sample of the super-donor.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a wide three-column alluvial diagram (Phylum, Order, Genus) with coloured bands. Panels B to E are circular multi-ring charts of concentric wedges for the Firmicutes, Proteobacteria, Bacteroidota and Fusobacteriota phyla, each with a small white centre label. Most per-wedge labels in B to E are too small to read.

panels.general_description: Alluvial (Sankey-style) diagram linking phylum, order and genus columns for the oral cavity sample.
panels.detailed_description: Three labelled columns, Phylum on the left, Order in the middle and Genus on the right, joined by curved translucent bands. Left column blocks: Campylobacterota (label above, no colour block), Actinobacteriota and Fusobacteriota (purple), Bacteroidota (yellow), Proteobacteria (pale lilac, large) and Firmicutes (green, largest). Middle column: Campylobacterales and Flavobacteriales labels at the top, Actinomycetales, Bacteroidales and Fusobacteriales (purple/yellow blocks), Lactobacillales (green), Enterobacterales (pale lilac) and Veillonellales-Selenomonadales (green, large). Right column: Campylobacter, Granulicatella and Capnocytophaga at the top, then Selenomonas, Leptotrichia, Actinomyces, Fusobacterium, Prevotella (yellow), Streptococcus (green), Haemophilus (pale lilac) and Veillonella (green, large). Band colours follow the phylum colours. No numeric values are printed.

limitations: Block heights are proportional areas without printed values; no values are read from them.

Phylum, order, and genus enrichment in the oral cavity sample of the super-donor.

Wedge labels around the outer ring are very small.
